summary: This program builds a larger list of farmers' market products and then runs three stream pipelines that each transform the data in a different way: pulling out the set of vendor names, formatting one vendor's products into a printable menu, and computing discounted prices for that vendor.

lines.text: This is the simplest kind of transformation: each MarketProduct flowing through the stream is replaced by just its vendor name, so a stream of products becomes a stream of Strings. The method reference is shorthand for the lambda p -> p.getVendor().

Collecting into a Set rather than a List discards duplicates automatically, which is why the three Baker's Lane products and three Sunny Fields Farm products each appear only once. A Set also has no guaranteed order, so the printed order may surprise you.
